children: Optical Cable reported third-quarter fiscal 2026 results with consolidated net sales of $24.3 million, up 22.0% year-over-year, and gross profit of $9.1 million, a 43.9% increase versus the prior-year quarter. The company posted net income of $1.9 million, or $0.21 per share, for the quarter and reported year-to-date net sales of $62.9 million through the first nine months. Management highlighted broad-based demand across enterprise, data center and specialty markets and an increased sales backlog entering the quarter end.
Revenue (three months ended July 31, 2026): $24.297 million, up 22.0% from $19.917 million a year earlier.
Gross profit (three months ended July 31, 2026): $9.095 million; gross margin: 37.4% (prior-year quarter: 31.7%).
Income from operations (three months ended July 31, 2026): $2.112 million.
Net income (three months ended July 31, 2026): $1.858 million, or $0.21 per basic and diluted share (three months ended July 31, 2025: $0.302 million, $0.04 per share).
Year-to-date (nine months ended July 31, 2026): net sales $62.942 million; gross profit $22.059 million; net income $2.515 million, or $0.28 per share.
Demand growth driven by enterprise, data center and specialty markets, with international sales rising faster than domestic in the quarter.
Net sales to U.S. customers increased 20.3% in the quarter; sales outside the U.S. increased 28.8% year-over-year for the quarter.
Sales order backlog/forward load increased to $13.5 million at July 31, 2026, up from $13.3 million at April 30, 2026 and $7.3 million at October 31, 2025, indicating strengthening near-term demand.
Company attributes improved gross margins to higher volumes and manufacturing operating leverage, reflecting improved operational efficiency.
Management emphasized continued focus on capturing domestic and international growth opportunities and delivering service across targeted market sectors.
